key_catalyst: Apple's 9% drop on weak current-quarter guidance, offset by Amazon's 15% AWS-driven surge
reasoning: Today's key catalyst, Apple's 9% plunge on soft guidance, is company-specific (AI component supply constraints) and has already been largely absorbed at the index level: QQQ is only -0.47% because Amazon's AWS blowout (+15%) and a 5-8% semiconductor rally offset the fund's heaviest weight. The macro drags (10-year at 4.74%, hawkish Warsh Fed with three dissents, Iran ultimatum) are recurring themes from this week, not novel shocks, and the market rallied +3.30% on 07-30 with yields already at 4.70% and the same hawkish Fed backdrop.
